Manual CLI smoke test was blocked by sandbox permissions (no approval surface available), but `npm test` ran cleanly and covers the new `parseDay` logic.

`habit done <name> [yesterday|YYYY-MM-DD]` now accepts an optional trailing date arg: `parseDay` (added to `src/streak.js`) resolves `"yesterday"` or an explicit `YYYY-MM-DD` string, and `src/cli.js` uses it to split the date off the name before calling `done()`; an invalid explicit date (e.g. `2026-13-40`) now returns an `Invalid date "..."` message instead of silently corrupting `habits.json`. Nothing needed deciding — behavior matches exactly what was asked.
